_comment: Shot list for deploy/render_video.py --reel. Five clips, six seconds each.
Fetch the footage first with deploy/fetch_footage.py --from_shots.
Every shot renders at 1280x720: four of the five sources are native 720p,
so a larger output would only upscale them. Crops are 16:9 by construction.
Licences and source pages are in credits.json beside this file.

shots.note: person riding horse; the crop is exactly 16:9 so nothing is pillarboxed

shots.credit: Ray Burrell, Metal Fabricator and Blacksmith · CC0
shots.note: uncropped: the full frame is native 1280x720 and keeps the sparks. Avoid 11-17 s, where the grinder arc blows out the camera's exposure

shots.credit: Technical Hardtail riding — Radde faehrt Radd · CC BY 3.0
shots.note: riding 0.79 - the clearest single-rider shot of the eleven cycling clips scanned

shots.credit: Jalebi being prepared, Bangalore — Subhashish Panigrahi · CC BY-SA 3.0
shots.note: the cook's head is never in frame in this clip; this window has the jalebi trays, pan and bowls

shots.credit: David Farmer, guitarist — Acabashi · CC BY-SA 4.0
shots.note: 4K source, so this shot downscales 3648->1280 and is the sharpest in the reel. det_conf 0.40 drops a tree trunk the segmenter calls 'horse'
